newsitem.title: JAPAN: ADNOC term naphtha premium set at $21/T-traders.
newsitem.headline: ADNOC term naphtha premium set at $21/T-traders.

text.p: Asian term lifters of Abu Dhabi National Oil Co's (ADNOC) naphtha have accepted ADNOC's offer price of $21 a tonne over the ADNOC formula for one-year supply contracts starting in July, traders said on Thursday.
The new term price marks a sharp increase from the previous premium of $6.80 per tonne over the ADNOC formula.

The term buyers -- one South Korean petrochemical firm, three Japanese trading houses and one Japanese oil firm -- are expected to buy a total 700,000 tonnes of naphtha from ADNOC during the term year.
In this year's negotiations that started in mid-May, ADNOC's initial offer was $22.50, while buyers countered with bids at around $19 to $20, traders said.
The premium for ADNOC term naphtha contracts that began in January is $11.50. -- Tokyo Energy Desk +81-3-3432-8837
